annotations.title: Suburb · Places of worship and community centres

description:
Christian churches, mosques, Hindu, Buddhist and Sikh temples, synagogues, community centres and halls, and cemeteries: counts in the suburb, rates per 1,000 residents and distance from the suburb centre to the nearest of each.

Coverage: All Australian suburbs and localities. Current to 2026-10-01. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/community-and-worship`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: count_churches, per_1000_churches, nearest_km_churches, count_mosques, per_1000_mosques, nearest_km_mosques, count_hindu_temples, per_1000_hindu_temples, nearest_km_hindu_temples, count_buddhist_temples, per_1000_buddhist_temples, nearest_km_buddhist_temples, count_sikh_temples, per_1000_sikh_temples, nearest_km_sikh_temples, count_synagogues, per_1000_synagogues, nearest_km_synagogues, count_community_centres, per_1000_community_centres, nearest_km_community_centres, count_cemeteries, per_1000_cemeteries, nearest_km_cemeteries, count_total, per_1000_total, per_km2_total. Omit for all.

suburb_name.description: Suburb name exactly as /v1/suburbs/list returns it, e.g. `Bondi` or `St Kilda (Vic.)`.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.
